Who we are: 
 Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world.
 We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with Talend expertise.
 What you will do: 
 As Data Engineer, you will participate in the different phases of Digital Transformation Projects by collecting, modelling, and rendering our data to help end user to perform an accurate analysis of their business through reports and Dashboards. You will play a crucial role in mentoring, sharing knowledge, and providing guidance to the Data Engineer Team. 
Follow architecture, strategy, and ETL pattern, in collaboration with Group ETL Core Team 
Assembling large, complex sets of data that meet non-functional and functional business requirements 
Support during project implementation: qualification, transformation and data integration 
Define Technical Prerequisites and Template 
Developing reusable ETL Jobs use cases 
Conception of connectors/jobs 
Development of Talend Jobs, deployment and commissioning of the interfaces 
Identifying, designing and implementing internal process improvements including re-designing infrastructure for greater scalability, optimizing data delivery, and automating manual processes 
Building required infrastructure for optimal extraction, transformation and loading of data from various data sources using ETL and SQL technologies 
Building analytical tools to utilize the data pipeline, providing actionable insight into key business performance metrics including operational efficiency and customer acquisition 
Significate experience on data engineering Cloud environment
Highly skilled in Microsoft SQL Server Stack (Data Base Engine) 
Advanced SQL, Query performance tuning Skills 
Very good Knowledge on Design Pattern of Data Product 
Demonstrate ability to manage multiple interfaces & deal with IT resources in international context 
Familiar with fully automated CI/CD Pipelines (Azure DevOps) for code deployment, integration and test automation, code quality and orchestration for automated build and release. 
Ability to manage Row Level Security on each Layer of the data Chain 
Familiar with ETL Feeding mechanisms (Delta/Full Loading, Historical data) 
Experience Building and Interacting with Data Lake/Lake House Solutions 
Good knowledge on agile methodology 
Working with stakeholders including data, design, product and executive teams and assisting them with data related technical issues 
Build Data Warehouses, Data Marts 
Maintain the ETL in operational condition 
Working with stakeholders including the Executive, Product, Data and Design teams to support their data infrastructure needs while assisting with data-related technical issues 
Familiarity with distributed query engines such as Trino (or equivalent). 
Knowledge of object storage systems such as MinIO (or equivalent) and distributed SQL query engines such as Trino. 
Strong understanding of modern data architectures, including the medallion architecture 
Support the qualification of the projects, extraction, transformation and load of the data (Data Scoping / Discovery) 
Technical Framing: Feasibility study, expression of needs, estimation of the load and timeframe
Writing Technical Specifications 
Ensure documentation of achievements 
Enrich solution components catalogue
 What you need to have: 
Tools: Talend Studio, Talend Data Integration Platform, Gitlab, Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL server Management Studio 
Expertise: CI/CD notions, Data Modelling, Talend, SQL, Agile, MinIO, Trino 
Fluency in English, both written and verbal
